basic_info.description: Significant Price Improvement!  Outstanding new construction in the vibrant Castro / Duboce Triangle neighborhood. This exceptional townhome features signature interiors by renowned designer, Alan Tse. Features include our most spacious floor plan with highly - appointed finishes and culinary inspired kitchens. This exquisite 3 Bedroom, 3.5 Bath home with 2977sf of living space, has it's own roof top patio with iconic views stretching from Sutro Tower to the Bay and Transamerica Building. This private space includes a gas grill which creates a unique indoor-outdoor living experience that is rare in the city. Another unique feature is that each home has its own private entrance off of quiet, tree-lined 15th Street along with elevator access to living areas for convenience and privacy.
